violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CORN AT 44-45F, MILK AT 49F, CREAM CHEESE AT 49F, SALSA AT 46F, SLICED CHEESE AT 47F, AND MILK AT 47F IN THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED ALL FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND MOVED ANY OTHER TCS FOODS THAT WERE STILL COLD HOLDING TO THE FREEZER. PIC WILL ENSURE THE COOLER IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER AT 46-54F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED TCS FOODS THAT WERE NOT COLD HOLDING AND MOVED ANY PROPERLY COLD HOLDING FOODS TO THE FREEZER. PIC CALLED A REPAIR TECHNICIAN DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE COOLER IS REPAIRED BY THE 19TH OF OCTOBER.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: OBSERVED EXPIRED BLEACH TEST KITS AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE OBTAIN A NEW BLEACH TEST KIT BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ABOVE BREAD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED CANNED FOODS STORED IN CRATES DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED CANS TO UNDER COUNTER CUPBOARD IN KITCHEN. PIC UNDERSTANDS CRATES ARE NOT BE USED TO STORE FOODS OR FOOD SERVICE ITEMS.
